title: Are We Experiencing The Mall World in Pieces?

classification.theory_summary: Proposes Mall World as a collective/shared experience akin to déjà vu; suggests people may encounter parts of their personal 'mall' in real life (e.g., airport/daycare/shopping center).
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream narrative or describable dream scene; only speculative theory and real-life comparison without phenomenological dream details.

meta.author_theory: Mall World may be a collective/shared experience like déjà vu; in waking life, parts of one's personal 'mall' (airport, daycare, shopping center) may appear/reveal themselves and feel significant.

extraction.extraction_notes: Mentions example place-types (airport, daycare, shopping center) only as speculative components of 'Mall World' and as waking-life sightings; no dream locations, layouts, transitions, entities, or events are described.
